item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Bug fix

Users on macOS 14 (Sonoma) saw an empty graph despite a healthy Apple Notes database. The root cause was a hardcoded CoreData entity discriminator that shifts between macOS versions. NotesMap now resolves the correct value dynamically from the schema metadata, so it works on every macOS version (current and future).

Diagnostic improvement

The diagnostic log added in v1.0.1 now records the resolved entity value, so future schema drift surfaces at a glance.

Thanks to Damien Schreurs for the detailed bug report that made this fix possible.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
What is new

  • Help menu has two new entries: Show Diagnostic Log in Finder (Cmd+Opt+L) and Copy Diagnostic Log to Clipboard.
  • Log file at ~/Library/Logs/NotesMap/NotesMap.log, mirrors to OSLog. Auto-rotates on each launch, keeps the 5 newest archives.
  • One-shot DB diagnostic on first build captures the NoteStore.sqlite shape (Z_ENT distribution, Z_PRIMARYKEY entity map, note counts) so schema mismatches across macOS versions can be pinpointed from a log file alone.

Privacy

No note content, titles, or folder names are ever logged. Only counts, status flags, and CoreData entity metadata. Nothing is sent anywhere automatically; log sharing is fully user-driven via the Help menu.
